medium.note: The lived rhythm. Damped about 0.83, so roughly 3.1 K peak-to-peak, some thirty times Earth's solar-cycle signal and the dominant climatic fact of any individual life. Fast enough to be planned around, too fast for ice to follow.

long.note: The geomorphic driver. Essentially undamped at 0.99, roughly 5.2 K peak-to-peak, slow enough that glaciers equilibrate rather than merely breathing. Each grand minimum is a distinct historical era.
